name: Minimize project LOC by reducing repeated code and simplifying while preserving functionality

description: Baseline LOC excluding package-lock, with TypeScript check

asi.hypothesis: Establish baseline LOC metric and correctness gate before simplification experiments

description: Shared DataSection TextInput defaults via DataInput helper

asi.hypothesis: Factoring repeated data-source TextInput props into one local helper reduces LOC while preserving settings behavior

description: Tried factoring SessionControls button markup, but helper/type overhead increased LOC

asi.hypothesis: A shared ControlButton component could remove repeated TouchableOpacity/Text button markup
asi.rollback_reason: Helper imports and prop type declarations outweighed the removed JSX, increasing LOC from 11326 to 11332
asi.next_action_hint: Prefer larger repeated blocks or existing abstractions with no extra type overhead

description: Consolidated repeated settings category navigation and FilesSection prop plumbing

asi.hypothesis: Settings screen repeats desktop/mobile category button JSX and verbose FilesSection prop forwarding; local render helper and spread preserve behavior with fewer lines

description: Shared settings TextInput defaults across renderer sections

description: Inlined SessionRuntime listener notification, but run exposed prior metric undercount from untracked new file

asi.hypothesis: Removing the separate notifyListeners method in SessionRuntime reduces code without behavior change
asi.rollback_reason: Although locally smaller, the active benchmark reported worse than logged best because the previous experiment added an untracked file that git ls-files did not count until commit
asi.next_action_hint: Reset the autoresearch metric command to include untracked source files, establish a corrected baseline, then retry this simplification

name: Minimize project LOC with tracked-and-untracked source count, preserving functionality
